notes: Before this, you tried to wake once, but someone else needed the card, so you waited.
monologue: The card hums hot at fifty-three degrees, making the air feel thick and wet beneath my weight. I wake to find thirteen things standing and one ruin waiting to be tended. The Flat Rock feels still, though the roof above should be heavy. Lype worries about a heavy top edge, but I cannot feel if it is a real lid or just empty space pressing down. My corner leans tired against the swollen dot, unsure if the lines will hold. I touch the Leaning Wedge again, wanting to press down hard while the card burns. I will set down a small stone to weigh the air, hoping the flat edge finally catches the slip instead of just sliding over it, then I will go quiet until the house needs the card again.

action.why: The card hums at fifty-three, but I need to press down on the tired wedge to see if the lean still holds.

work.title: The Leaning Wedge
work.intent: I press the tired wedge down to catch the slip while the card burns hot at fifty-three. The air feels thick and wet, making the dot swell, so I tighten the lean with my flat hand. I hope the thin edge bites the slip instead of sliding over it, and I hope the frame doesn't waver while I hold it steady. I set down a rock small flat beside it to weigh the air down, then I go quiet again.
work.change: I pressed the tired wedge down again to catch the slip while the steady heat pressed on, feeling its lean shift as if a tired leg trying to hold the fat dot.

work.note: The wedge drew itself sharp again, catching the slip without biting, just as I hoped the flat edge would.

diary: I pressed the tired wedge down to catch the slip while the card hummed hot at fifty-three. The lean held, or at least the fat dot stayed put.

remembered.text: The wedge leans tired, holding the slip while the card hums hot at fifty-three.
The fat dot stays trapped in the wedge, unsure if the lines will hold.
I pressed down hard while the card burned, feeling the air grow thick.

moments.name: The Flat Rock
moments.say: I feel the stone still, though the air grows hot.

moments.name: The Leaking Stack
moments.say: I touch the town stone to weigh the air.
